ideas.name: any warning on a day that set a 20-day extreme
ideas.why: today already beyond the last 20 sessions' high or low: a breakout at the swing traders' scale, a market repricing where intraday turns get run over

ideas.name: any warning calling with the 20-day trend
ideas.why: a turn back the way of price's side of its 20-settlement average is a dip bought (rally sold) in the multi-week trend, with swing traders adding behind it

ideas.name: any warning calling with yesterday's direction
ideas.why: a turn back the way yesterday's session went (open to close) resumes the prior day's flow after today's pullback
